lines.text: و غیره در باب نوزدهم معلوم گردد انشاء الله تعالی و ارس سعودین و کید نحس اما سعادت
lines.en: and others will become known in the nineteenth chapter, God willing. And the head of the two benefics and the tail of the malefic, but the beneficence

lines.text: ارس تا آنجهت است که قمر در حال صعود و عرض کجاوز کند در معظم معموره اما نحوست ذنب بجهت
lines.en: of the head is because the Moon, while ascending and in latitude, crosses the greater part of the inhabited world. But the maleficence of the tail is because

lines.text: آنست که قمر در حال هبوط عرض از عقده ذنب مجاورت نماید در اکثر ربع مسکون و
lines.en: the Moon, while descending in latitude from the node of the tail, is adjacent to most of the inhabited quarter. And

lines.text: بعضی گفته اند که راس چون سعد مجاسد او باشد سعد بود و چون نحس مجاسد او باشد
lines.en: some have said that the head, when a benefic is conjoined with it, is benefic, and when a malefic is conjoined with it,

lines.text: نحس بود و ذنب بخلاف این یعنی چون سعدی مجاسد او باشد نحس بود و چون نحسی
lines.en: is malefic. And the tail is the opposite of this, meaning when a benefic is conjoined with it, it is malefic, and when a malefic

lines.text: مجاسد او باشد سعد و بعضی دیگر گفته اند که فعل ارس افزودنست و فعل ذنب کم
lines.en: is conjoined with it, it is benefic. And some others have said that the action of the head is to increase, and the action of the tail is to decrease.

lines.text: کردن یعنی هر کوکب که ممازج ارس بود قوت او زیاده شود و هر کوکب که ممازج ذنب
lines.en: Meaning, any planet that is mixed with the head, its strength increases, and any planet that is mixed with the tail,

lines.text: بود قوت او کم شود و کید چون کوکبیست متوهم پس نحوست او نیز متوهم باشد و بر
lines.en: its strength decreases. And the tail, since it is an imaginary planet, its maleficence is also imaginary. And upon

lines.text: آن دلیلی نبود و عطارد تابع متصلت یعنی متصل به است نه نحس باشد و نه سعد چه
lines.en: that there is no proof. And Mercury is a follower of the one it is connected to, meaning the one it is connected to, it is neither malefic nor benefic, because

lines.text: میانه طائفه ای نیرین و طائفه ای او نظری واقع نیست بلکه ساقط اند از یکدیگر پس
lines.en: between the group of the two luminaries and its group there is no aspect, but rather they are fallen from each other. So

lines.text: تابع کوکبی باشد که متصل یا متصل به او باشد چنانکه اگر آن کوکب سعد باشد
lines.en: it is a follower of the planet that is connected or connected to it, such that if that planet is benefic,

lines.text: سعد گردد و اگر نحس باشد نحس بعد هذا بر اذهان از کیا مخفی نماند که اثاریکه بر عالم کون و
lines.en: it becomes benefic, and if it is malefic, it becomes malefic. After this, it should not remain hidden from the minds of the intelligent that the effects that are upon the world of generation and

lines.text: فساد واقع میشود هر اینه بوجود مؤثري ومتاثري و شرطي باشد مؤثر را فاعل خوانند و متاثرا
lines.en: corruption occur, in any case, by the existence of an effector and an affected and a condition, the effector is called the agent and the affected

lines.text: اهل قابل و فاعل نزد تحقیق قدرت اللهي است و احکاميان اوضاع نجومي را شرط دانند
lines.en: the people of the capable and the agent, according to investigation, is the power of God, and the astrologers consider the astrological positions as a condition

lines.text: و گویند که تجدد هر متجدد بر حصول آن شرط است چه بسبب حصول آن شرط تجدد وقتی
lines.en: and they say that the renewal of every renewed thing is upon the occurrence of that condition, because by reason of the occurrence of that condition, the renewal of a time

lines.text: خاص شده است دون وقت دیگر و قابل اجسام این عالم باشد و انچه متعلق باجسام
lines.en: has become specific, excluding another time. And the capable one is the bodies of this world and what is attached to the bodies,

lines.text: است مانند صور و نفوس و اعراض و آثاری که بر این قوابل فایض میشود بحسب تجربه
lines.en: such as forms, souls, accidents, and effects that emanate upon these capable ones, according to experience,

lines.text: مختلف یافته اند و گویند این اختلاف یا بحسب طبایع مواضع کواکب باشد و از بروج یا
lines.en: they have found to be different. And they say this difference is either according to the natures of the positions of the planets and from the signs, or

lines.text: بحسب اختلاف اماکن در زمان یا بسبب حالاتیکه کواکب را در جهات واقع میشود چنانکه
lines.en: according to the difference of places in time, or because of the states that occur to the planets in directions, such as

summary.headline: Lunar Nodes and Planetary Effects
summary.text: Discussion of the lunar nodes’ benefic and malefic effects, including opposing theories about the head and tail, and Mercury’s dependence on the planet connected with it. The text then explains astrological positions as conditions governing changes in the world of generation and corruption, influenced by planetary natures, signs, places, times, and planetary directions; Khwaja Nasir al-Din Tusi is cited in a marginal note.
